svg.aria-label: The abstract-only mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Abstract agent (agent); Abstract and keywords (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md, the paper type, the language and the claims not to make [D24, AD12, AI2]; a file given in words found by search [AQ] (stop); Session: grep for the file that holds the abstract environment, since the patch must name that file [C] (script); Draft writer, in place of the abstract agent: abstract and keywords, one patch, its parts and lengths by paper type, its own text checked against the prose standard [T, AJ, AV18] (ruled); Abstract and keywords (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [C] (stop); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).
